articles.title_en: Singles, Couples, and Their Labor Supply: Long-Run Trends and Short-Run Fluctuations
articles.title_cn: 单身者、夫妻及其劳动供给：长期趋势与短期波动
articles.abstract_en: Women's increased involvement in the economy has been an important change in labor markets during the past century. I show that a macroeconomic model taking into account gender and household composition in an otherwise parsimonious off-the-shelf setting captures key historical labor supply facts regarding trend and volatility across subgroups. Evaluating the economy's response to aggregate shocks at different points in time shows that the underlying trend growth in married women's employment contributed to the perceived quick employment recoveries after recessions before 1990, and the absence of growth thereafter consequently helps explain the more recent slower recoveries. (JEL D13, E24, E32, J12, J16, J22)
articles.abstract_cn: 女性在经济中参与度的提高是过去一个世纪劳动力市场的重要变化。我展示了一个在其余方面简约的现成设定中考虑性别和家庭构成的宏观经济模型，能够捕捉各子群体在趋势和波动性方面的关键历史劳动供给事实。评估经济在不同时间点对总体冲击的反应表明，已婚女性就业的潜在趋势增长促成了1990年之前衰退后看似迅速的就业复苏，而此后增长的缺失则有助于解释近期较慢的复苏。(JEL D13, E24, E32, J12, J16, J22)

articles.abstract_en: In this paper we identify demand shocks that can have a permanent effect on output through hysteresis effects. We call these shocks permanent demand shocks. They are found to be quantitatively important in the United States, in particular in samples starting in the 1980s. Recessions driven by permanent demand shocks lead to a permanent decline in employment and investment, while output per worker is largely unaffected. We find strong evidence that hysteresis transmits through a rise in long-term unemployment and a decline in labor force participation and disproportionately affects the least productive workers. (JEL C51, E22, E23, E24, E32, J22, J24)
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们识别了通过滞后效应对产出产生永久影响的需求冲击。我们将这些冲击称为永久性需求冲击。研究发现，这些冲击在美国具有重要的数量意义，尤其是在从1980年开始的样本中。由永久性需求冲击驱动的衰退导致就业和投资的永久性下降，而人均产出基本不受影响。我们找到强有力的证据表明，滞后效应通过长期失业率上升和劳动力参与率下降来传导，并且对生产率最低的工人影响尤为显著。(JEL C51, E22, E23, E24, E32, J22, J24)

articles.title_en: The Evolution of US Retail Concentration
articles.title_cn: 美国零售集中度的演变
articles.abstract_en: Increasing national concentration has contributed to market power concerns. Yet local trends are more informative about market power in retail, where consumers have traditionally shopped at nearby stores. Using novel product-level census data for all US retailers, we find that local and national concentration increased in parallel and affect most markets, products, and industries. The expansion of multimarket firms into new markets explains most of the increase in national concentration, with consolidation via increases in local market shares increasing in importance between 1997 and 2007. Increases in local concentration can explain one-quarter to one-third of the observed rise in retail gross margins. (JEL D22, L13, L81, R32)
articles.abstract_cn: 国家层面集中度的上升引发了市场势力的担忧。然而，对于零售业而言，消费者传统上在附近商店购物，因此地方趋势更能反映市场势力。利用覆盖所有美国零售商的新型产品级普查数据，我们发现地方和国家集中度同步上升，并影响了大多数市场、产品和行业。多市场企业向新市场的扩张解释了国家集中度上升的大部分原因，而通过提高地方市场份额进行的整合在1997年至2007年间的重要性日益增加。地方集中度的上升可以解释零售毛利率观察到的上升的四分之一至三分之一。（JEL D22, L13, L81, R32）

articles.title_en: Permanent Income Shocks, Target Wealth, and the Wealth Gap
articles.title_cn: 永久性收入冲击、目标财富与财富差距
articles.abstract_en: We test the key implication of the buffer-stock model, namely that any revision in permanent income leads to a proportionate revision in target wealth. We use panel data on the amount of wealth that people think they must hold for precautionary purposes. Using the covariance restrictions that the model imposes on the joint behavior of income and target wealth, we find that households indeed revise, approximately one for one, their target wealth in response to permanent income shocks. The speed of adjustment of actual wealth to target wealth is similar to that obtained in simulations of a buffer-stock model. (JEL D15, E21, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们检验了缓冲储备模型的关键含义，即永久收入的任何修正都会导致目标财富的按比例修正。我们使用了关于人们认为必须为预防性目的持有的财富金额的面板数据。利用模型对收入和目标财富联合行为施加的协方差限制，我们发现家庭确实大约一对一地根据永久性收入冲击修正其目标财富。实际财富向目标财富调整的速度与缓冲储备模型模拟中得到的结果相似。(JEL D15, E21, G51)

articles.title_en: From Blue- to Steel-Collar Jobs: The Decline in Employment Gaps?
articles.title_cn: 从蓝领到钢领工作：就业差距的缩小？
articles.abstract_en: I investigate how the introduction of industrial robots is shaping the demographic composition of the US labor force between 1993 and 2014. I find that robots decreased employment of men and women by 3.7 and 1.6 percentage points, contributing to the secular decline in the gender employment gap, and that they decreased employment among Whites and non-Whites by 1.8 and 4.5 percentage points, widening the race/ethnicity employment gap. These effects follow from the persistent occupational segregation in the labor market. Although robots are primarily used in manufacturing, their adverse effects spill over to local service industries, in particular for Blacks and Hispanics. (JEL E24, J15, J16, L60, O33, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了工业机器人的引入如何在1993年至2014年间塑造美国劳动力的 demographic 构成。我发现机器人使男性和女性的就业率分别下降了3.7和1.6个百分点，促进了性别就业差距的长期缩小，同时使白人和非白人的就业率分别下降了1.8和4.5个百分点，扩大了种族/民族就业差距。这些效应源于劳动力市场中持续的职业隔离。尽管机器人主要用于制造业，但其不利影响波及到当地服务业，尤其是对黑人和西班牙裔人群。(JEL E24, J15, J16, L60, O33, R23)

articles.title_en: Medical Expenses and Saving in Retirement: The Case of the United States and Sweden
articles.title_cn: 医疗支出与退休储蓄：美国和瑞典的案例
articles.abstract_en: Many US households have significant wealth late in life, contrary to the predictions of a simple life-cycle model. By comparison, retirees in Sweden decumulate wealth more quickly while facing smaller out-of-pocket medical expense risks late in life. In this paper, we investigate how well the latter can account for the former using a full life-cycle consumption-saving model. We find that medical expense level and risk account for 32–59 percent of the US-Sweden difference in retirees' speed of wealth decumulation depending on age. We also show that financing and coverage of health insurance affect wealth decumulation patterns in retirement. (JEL D15, G22, G51, I13, J14, J26)
articles.abstract_cn: 许多美国家庭在晚年拥有大量财富，这与简单生命周期模型的预测相反。相比之下，瑞典的退休人员在晚年面临较小的自付医疗支出风险，同时更快地减少财富积累。在本文中，我们使用完整的生命周期消费-储蓄模型来研究后者在多大程度上可以解释前者。我们发现，医疗支出水平和风险解释了美国与瑞典退休人员财富减少速度差异的32-59%，具体取决于年龄。我们还表明，健康保险的融资和覆盖范围影响退休期间的财富减少模式。（JEL D15, G22, G51, I13, J14, J26）

articles.title_en: Optimal Bank Reserve Remuneration and Capital Control Policy
articles.title_cn: 最优银行准备金报酬与资本控制政策
articles.abstract_en: A central prediction of open economy models with a pecuniary externality due to a collateral constraint is that the unregulated economy overborrows relative to what occurs under optimal policy. A maintained assumption in this literature is that households borrow directly from foreign lenders. This paper shows that if foreign lending is intermediated by domestic banks and the government can pay interest on bank reserves and impose capital controls, the unregulated economy underborrows. The optimal bank reserve policy is countercyclical. By increasing bank reserves during contractions, the government acts as a lender of last resort to collateral-constrained households. (JEL E32, E58, F38, F41, G21, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 开放经济模型中，由于抵押约束导致的金钱外部性，一个核心预测是未受监管的经济相对于最优政策下的情况会过度借贷。该文献中的一个维持假设是家庭直接从外国贷款者借款。本文表明，如果外国贷款通过国内银行中介，并且政府能够对银行准备金支付利息并实施资本控制，那么未受监管的经济会借贷不足。最优银行准备金政策是逆周期的。通过在收缩期间增加银行准备金，政府充当了受抵押约束家庭的最后贷款人。(JEL E32, E58, F38, F41, G21, G51)

articles.title_en: US Treasury Auctions: A High-Frequency Identification of Supply Shocks
articles.title_cn: 美国国债拍卖：供应冲击的高频识别
articles.abstract_en: We identify Treasury supply shocks using auction data, interpreting changes in futures prices around announcements as shocks to expected supply. We isolate the component of futures price variations pertaining to US Treasury announcements between 1998 and 2020. We study how supply affects financial markets through local projections, using shocks as instruments. We show that increases in Treasury supply cause an upward shift of the yield curve fueled partly by a higher term premium. Stock prices decline, volatility climbs, and corporate bond yields increase. The risk premium rises, the equity premium falls, inflation expectations soar, and the liquidity premium decreases. (JEL E43, E44, E63, G13, G14, H63)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用拍卖数据识别国债供应冲击，将公告前后期货价格的变化解释为预期供应的冲击。我们分离了1998年至2020年间与美国国债公告相关的期货价格变动成分。我们通过局部投影研究供应如何影响金融市场，并使用冲击作为工具变量。我们表明，国债供应的增加导致收益率曲线上移，部分原因是期限溢价上升。股票价格下跌，波动性上升，公司债券收益率增加。风险溢价上升，股票溢价下降，通胀预期飙升，流动性溢价下降。(JEL E43, E44, E63, G13, G14, H63)

articles.title_en: Rational Inattention and the Business Cycle Effects of Productivity and News Shocks
articles.title_cn: 理性疏忽与生产率和新闻冲击的商业周期效应
articles.abstract_en: We solve a real business cycle model with rational inattention (an RI-RBC model). In the RI-RBC model, the growth rates of employment, investment, and output are about as persistent as in the data, with an amount of inattention consistent with survey data on expectations. Moreover, consumption, employment, and output move in the same direction in response to news about future productivity. By contrast, the baseline RBC model produces neither persistent growth rates nor business cycle comovement after news shocks. (JEL D83, E32, E71)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们求解了一个具有理性疏忽的真实商业周期模型（RI-RBC模型）。在RI-RBC模型中，就业、投资和产出的增长率与数据中的持续性相当，且疏忽程度与调查数据中的预期一致。此外，消费、就业和产出对未来生产率新闻的反应方向相同。相比之下，基准RBC模型既不能产生持续的增长率，也不能在新闻冲击后产生商业周期联动。（JEL D83, E32, E71）

articles.abstract_en: The Soviet regime forcedly sent millions of enemies of the people, i.e. the educated elite considered a threat to the regime, to Gulag camps across the USSR. We use this large-scale episode of terror as a natural experiment to provide evidence on the long-run persistence of human capital across generations and its effect on economic growth. We combine archive data from the Gulag with the 2018 Russian firm census to show that areas around camps with a larger share of enemies among camp prisoners are more prosperous today, as captured by firms' wages and profits, and night lights per capita. (JEL D22, J24, J82, N34, N94, P31, R12)
articles.abstract_cn: 苏联政权强制将数百万“人民公敌”，即被视为对政权构成威胁的受过教育的精英，送往遍布苏联的古拉格集中营。我们将这一大规模恐怖事件作为自然实验，为人力资本跨代长期持续性及其对经济增长的影响提供证据。我们将古拉格的档案数据与2018年俄罗斯企业普查相结合，表明在集中营周围地区，囚犯中“人民公敌”比例较高的地方如今更加繁荣，这体现在企业工资、利润以及人均夜间灯光数据上。（JEL D22, J24, J82, N34, N94, P31, R12）

articles.title_en: Spatial Integration and Agricultural Productivity: Quantifying the Impact of New Roads
articles.title_cn: 空间整合与农业生产力：量化新道路的影响
articles.abstract_en: I study the effects of Ethiopia's 1997–2014 road expansion program on agricultural productivity and structural change by combining a quantitative spatial sectoral framework with novel district-level panel data on agricultural production and geocoded transport costs. In the model, the spatial heterogeneity of transport costs affects the distribution of production and mobile inputs across locations and sectors, and the allocation of land across crops within locations. Varying transport costs to their new actual levels, the model delivers substantial structural change, a rise in agricultural productivity onetenth of the data, and a pattern of productivity gains across districts consistent with the data. (JEL H54, O13, O18, Q11, Q13, R42, R53)
articles.abstract_cn: 我通过结合定量空间部门框架与新颖的区级农业生产和地理编码运输成本面板数据，研究了埃塞俄比亚1997-2014年道路扩建计划对农业生产力和结构变化的影响。在模型中，运输成本的空间异质性影响生产和流动要素在不同地点和部门间的分布，以及地点内土地在作物间的分配。将运输成本调整至其新的实际水平，模型产生了显著的结构变化，农业生产力提升为数据的十分之一，以及各区生产力增长的模式与数据一致。(JEL H54, O13, O18, Q11, Q13, R42, R53)

articles.title_en: State-Dependent Government Spending Multipliers: Downward Nominal Wage Rigidity and Sources of Business Cycle Fluctuations
articles.title_cn: 状态依赖的政府支出乘数：向下名义工资刚性与经济周期波动的来源
articles.abstract_en: In a New Keynesian model with downward nominal wage rigidity (DNWR), we show that government spending is more effective in stimulating output in a low-inflation recession relative to a high-inflation recession. The government spending multiplier is large when DNWR binds, but the nature of recession matters due to the opposing response of inflation and, consequently, for real wages. Using US historical time series data, we provide evidence of larger spending multipliers in low-inflation recessions and the importance of the depth of recessions. We also employ cross-sectional data from US states to document supporting evidence on multipliers and our proposed mechanism. (JEL E12, E24, E31, E32, E62, H50)
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个具有向下名义工资刚性（DNWR）的新凯恩斯模型中，我们表明，相对于高通胀衰退，政府支出在低通胀衰退中更能有效刺激产出。当DNWR约束起作用时，政府支出乘数较大，但衰退的性质很重要，因为通胀的反应相反，从而影响实际工资。利用美国历史时间序列数据，我们提供了低通胀衰退中较大支出乘数的证据，以及衰退深度的重要性。我们还利用美国各州的横截面数据来记录关于乘数和我们提出的机制的支持性证据。（JEL E12, E24, E31, E32, E62, H50）

articles.title_en: Wealth Inequality, Aggregate Consumption, and Macroeconomic Trends under Incomplete Markets
articles.title_cn: 不完全市场下的财富不平等、总消费与宏观经济趋势
articles.abstract_en: I construct an incomplete market model featuring a closed-form expression for optimal consumption. In the model, individual consumption is an isoelastic function of wealth, inclusive of income, yielding partial consumption smoothing based on borrowing and lending in response to income shocks. I show that the model replicates several empirical characteristics of inequality in consumption, income, and wealth and their dynamics at the individual level. Using the model, I show that the rising wealth inequality since the 1980s, induced by an increase in idiosyncratic income risk, has substantially contributed to trend-level changes in real interest rates, capital-to-income ratios, and consumption-to-wealth ratios. (JEL D31, D52, E21, E43, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我构建了一个不完全市场模型，该模型具有最优消费的闭式表达式。在模型中，个人消费是财富（含收入）的等弹性函数，基于对收入冲击的借贷反应，实现部分消费平滑。我证明该模型能够复现消费、收入和财富不平等及其个体层面动态的若干经验特征。利用该模型，我表明自1980年代以来，由个体收入风险增加所导致的财富不平等加剧，已显著促进了实际利率、资本收入比和消费财富比的趋势性变化。(JEL D31, D52, E21, E43, G51)
